charts.line_description: How one or more series moved over the range. The default when the question is 'is this getting worse'.
charts.area_description: How a total splits between the values of one label, over time. Counters only — stacking gauges adds up numbers that were never a total.
charts.bar_description: One number per label value for the whole range. The question is 'which one is worst', not 'when did it happen'.
charts.stat_description: The current value with a sparkline and the change against the previous range. What the built-in signal tiles are.
charts.table_description: Several series side by side, one row per label value. For comparing more columns than a chart can carry.

notes.no_approved_metric: no approved metric named {metrics} in this environment

errors.panel_too_few_series: panel {panel:%q}: {type} needs at least {min} series, got {got}
